status: Registered before any phase morphology, pathway classification, or comparison-window outcome is inspected.
control_exposure: At N32 and N48 use all three reversible controls from the original extent phase. The full domain-history exposure is [1200,T] at each matched N and seed. Directly check the B-fraction bracket and gross reaction frequency on that same ledger interval. Report the paired rows and signs for positive and negative contributions without extrapolation or declaring an event-count law.
transport_comparator: For strict separated losses compare the observed cohort's late entry among its dilute-marked particles with a uniform draw from all particles dilute at the same intermediate frame, using the same distinct persistent recipients. This is an exact conditional expectation for the observed states; it does not impose mixing or establish an advantage in transport.
volume_transfer: For groups of at least two one-to-one successors within an interval, compare the symmetric fixed-mask net transfer and the measured inventory change of the initially largest and smallest regions by material count. Skip tied largest-smallest populations. Summarize all within-history intervals and both cadences.
figure_selection: For an illustrative witnessed path, choose the largest available driven box with a strict loss and at least one same-ID dilute-to-recipient route. Within that size use the 0.5, 50-unit definition when available, then greatest witnessed transfer, and the lowest seed and earliest time to break ties. Label it as a selected illustrative case. If no witnessed path exists display all conditions with a registered census timelapse and state the negative result.
